subject.why: The trail consists of bare human footprints with toes rather than boot prints.

category.why: The scene features a plain surface and single-tone gradient wall matching the requirements.

clean.why: No text, UI, frames, or visible characters are present.

framing.why: The boots are nicely framed with ample margins and a clear silhouette.

colour.why: Saturated purple backdrop contrasts well with the green boots.

detail.why: The scattered toe prints create busy micro-detail across the ground plane.

style.why: Smooth, chunky forms and satin surfaces align with the reference art.

bg_colour.why: background is grey/dark (52% of the background); the plan asks for purple

fix: Make the background purple: Plain soft lilac-purple flat surface and a smooth purple wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.. Replace the bare footprints with simplified boot tread marks to reduce floor clutter and match the footwear.
